correctness.rationale: The first nonzero singleton Fourier row forces h0=C character and f,g nowherezero. The exact adjacent two-character ratio telescopes along the generating step. Root q has exact order d, full d-block product equals a nonzero scalar, and all coefficients of each r<d Gaussian-binomial partial product are nonzero with distinct frequency characters. Therefore every row count is exactly 1+(j mod d), and the total is N(d+1)/2. An explicit positive binomial ratio with unit cyclic product constructs f,g for every d|N,d>1. A standalone finite checker confirmed 19,058 STFT entries, without being used as infinite proof.
